params.baseInstructions: Complete the supplied mathematical task using only its explicit inputs and tools. Submit the requested JSON artifact through submit_artifact. Tool feedback is real task feedback; do not invent a successful check. This is a Yui workflow stage. Read the relevant declared Yui rules, preserve the supplied proof route and exact allowed assumptions, and distinguish mathematical review from structural checks.

dynamicTools.name: search_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: 在固定 mathlib 的 Lean 源码中搜索正则表达式，返回至多 100 行。

dynamicTools.name: read_mathlib
dynamicTools.description: 读取固定 mathlib 中一个 Mathlib/...lean 文件的指定行。

dynamicTools.name: read_task_input
dynamicTools.description: Read an explicitly frozen task document by ID; no other local files are accessible.

dynamicTools.name: read_yui
dynamicTools.description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

dynamicTools.name: check_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

dynamicTools.name: submit_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

dynamicTools.name: report_obstacle
dynamicTools.description: Stop this stage honestly on a substantive or suspected proof gap, unavailable source, or input conflict. JSON fields: status, location, explanation, basis, partial_progress. Status must be SUBSTANTIVE_GAP, SUSPECTED_GAP, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or INPUT_CONFLICT. Difficulty alone is not a mathematical error.

input.text:
Resolve one concrete source/representation obligation in the existing cover/slicing proof, without rewriting the whole graph. Read every task document and relevant Yui authoring/self-containment rules. The last author could not connect its covering contents to the pinned Mathlib Hausdorff measure and then stopped. This is an unfinished interface obligation, not an established mathematical gap. Inspect the actual pinned definitions/theorems using search_mathlib/read_mathlib. Give an explicit mathematically correct covering-content definition consistent with that library and a complete derivation of its small-scale relation to Hausdorff measure; clarify countable covers, zero diameter, real/ENNReal exponents, limits and any normalization rather than claiming an unspecified positive factor is harmless. Also give the precise measure-theoretic input statements and complete application argument needed to integrate the nonnegative indicator-series lower bound from the candidate. Locate exact library definitions and general theorem candidates with file/line references, and distinguish imported facts from explicit derived steps. Do not re-prove the entire exercise, invent library names or assume the desired product-dimension equality. Preserve the existing slicing route and all degeneracies including n=0 and zero-dimensional E. If another routine omission in that same candidate affects this bridge, identify its exact repair. Submit JSON {status,bridge_statement,complete_derivation,source_inventory,remaining_obligations}. Your source inventory is a candidate until actual signature probes and Audit A. Do not use report_obstacle solely because an ordinary library/definition conversion needs more work.
